# pip-audit allowlist for security-scan.yml (2026-09-24).
#
# One vulnerability id per line; text after '#' is ignored. security-scan.yml
# passes every id here as --ignore-vuln, so pip-audit FAILS the job on any
# vulnerability against requirements.txt that is not listed. This is a
# ratchet, not an approval: every id below was already open on main when the
# scan was made able to fail (run 35899264704, 7cedda5), and the reason each
# pin is still held is the one docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md #1 gives (upgrading risks
# the langchain compatibility that has not been integration-tested).
#
# KNOWN_ISSUES.md names seven pins. pip-audit finds 48 vulnerable packages in
# the resolved set (transitive pins included) and 0 open ids against
# pydantic 2.9.2, so that document is out of date in both directions; the
# truth is this file. Remove a package's block when its pin moves; a bump
# that leaves an id open fails the job, which is the point.
#
# Regenerate from a report: python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('pip-audit-report.json'));[print(v['id'],'#',x['name']+'=='+x['version']) for x in d['dependencies'] for v in x.get('vulns',[])]"
